adjudication.rationale: The finding is accurate. In CalendarManager.ts, createEvent receives an externalId parameter (line 219-220) but this externalId is never passed to the calendar.createEvent call (line 237). The Calendar interface was updated to accept credentialId (line 237 passes credential.id), but the externalId is only returned in the result object (line 267) rather than being used to select the correct calendar. This forces adapters like GoogleCalendarService to re-match the destination calendar from the array using credentialId (lines 145-148), while non-Google adapters like LarkCalendarService and Office365CalendarService simply use array position zero (e.g., 'const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []'). This is a real architectural inconsistency that could cause events to be created in the wrong calendar for non-Google adapters in multi-calendar scenarios.
